verses.english: “Mendicants, this transmigration has no known beginning.

verses.pali: Pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṁ sattānaṁ taṇhāsaṁyojanānaṁ sandhāvataṁ saṁsarataṁ.
verses.english: No first point is found of sentient beings roaming and transmigrating, shrouded by ignorance and fettered by craving.

verses.pali: Na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo na dhītābhūtapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā.
verses.english: It’s not easy to find a sentient being who in all this long time has not previously been your daughter.
This transmigration has no known beginning.

verses.pali: Pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṁ sattānaṁ taṇhāsaṁyojanānaṁ sandhāvataṁ saṁsarataṁ.
verses.english: No first point is found of sentient beings roaming and transmigrating, shrouded by ignorance and fettered by craving.

verses.pali: Evaṁ dīgharattaṁ vo, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ paccanubhūtaṁ tibbaṁ paccanubhūtaṁ byasanaṁ paccanubhūtaṁ, kaṭasī vaḍḍhitā.
verses.english: For such a long time you have undergone suffering, agony, and disaster, swelling the cemeteries.

verses.pali: Yāvañcidaṁ, bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṁ, alaṁ virajjituṁ, alaṁ vimuccitun”ti.
verses.english: This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”
